title: Unhuman Music
method: R1 素读：仅读 text/ch35_unhuman_music.txt，未打开 ch35 md。三段日期：2014-04-19（Alba 12, Isadora 5）/ 2014-05-06（Alba 12）/ 2014-07-16（Alba 39, Beck 38）。

facts.fact: 2014 年 4 月 19 日（Alba 12、Isadora 5）：Alba 本来睡在 Nadia 家，却落在自家地下室 Beck 的工作室里，裸体、黑暗、不知是哪一天——两天里第三次时间旅行。她开了落地灯，Isadora 先问「Beck？」，再问「Who is it?」声音害怕，把灯全打开，电话响，答录机接起；Alba 想上楼拿衣服和食物，但门上有警报。
facts.quote: I turn on one of the floor lamps and Isadora says, “Beck?” … Then Isadora asks, “Who is it?” She sounds scared. She turns on all the lights and the phone starts ringing. I wait to see if anyone answers; the machine picks up. I want to go upstairs—I want clothes and food—but the door has an alarm.

facts.fact: Isadora 在屏幕里是一只待在纸箱里的黑猫，坐在一间空白的白房间里；她说「I don’t know where ‘everybody’ is. I am Nowhere.」，Alba 笑称「You’re a Nowhere Cat」，她恼了：「I’m a Nowhere Girl. Isn’t it obvious?」，并放起披头士的「Nowhere Man」。她说这地方是她自己造的、想事情时来，因为「I get tired of other people’s things」；又说 Beck 刚给她的博物馆添了凡尔赛，她还是更喜欢这里。
facts.quote: “Hello, Alba.” The monitor lights up. Isadora is a black cat inside a cardboard box, sitting in an empty white room. I like her better now that’s she’s a cat. “I don’t know where ‘everybody’ is. I am Nowhere.” … “I’m a Nowhere Girl,” she says. She sounds kind of annoyed. “Isn’t it obvious?”

facts.fact: Isadora 说「I did not always appear to be a cat」——Beck 会把她改一点、或者改很多；又说「Beck tells me that I like boxes.」，跳出来绕箱子几圈再跳回去，说「I feel correct here.」；Alba 说自己不能造毛皮，「I’m a meat girl, stuck in meatspace.」
facts.quote: “I can’t. I have to be how I am. I’m a meat girl, stuck in meatspace.” / “I don’t think I have to be how I am. Beck changes me a little, or a lot. I did not always appear to be a cat.” … “Beck tells me that I like boxes.”

facts.fact: Alba 求她别告诉 Beck 自己来过，Isadora 欢快地说「Oh, I never tell Beck when we talk by ourselves.」；随后楼上传来快门声、前门开了、有人上楼，Beck 喊「Isadora？」，Isadora 立刻撒谎：「Is that you, Beck? I thought I heard burglars upstairs!」Alba 躲进父亲的书箱后面，Beck 下来只打字、什么都没对 Isadora 说，关灯走了；Alba 刚起身就被时间旅行拉回 Nadia 的卧室，绊倒乐高迷你高尔夫、脚流血，Rosa 与 Nadia 起来替她擦地；她满脑子想的是「Isadora lies to Beck」，不知道该不该说。
facts.quote: “Oh, I never tell Beck when we talk by ourselves,” Isadora replies cheerfully. … Beck says, “Isadora?” and Isadora says, “Is that you, Beck? I thought I heard burglars upstairs!” … all I can think about is Isadora lies to Beck and I don’t know if I should tell Beck

facts.fact: 2014 年 5 月 6 日（Alba 12）：Alba 又在地下室，头痛、白天，Isadora 的屏幕全黑、机架上灯乱闪；她担心 Mama、Beck 和 Other Alba 在密歇根陪外祖父 Abshire，可能几天没人回家；她按 Return 唤醒摄像头。Isadora 说「Go away. I have work to do.」，正在用 Beck 给的一堆模糊照片重建 Joseph Cornell 的工作室，还叫她去拉小提琴。
facts.quote: “Go away. I have work to do.” … “I’m reconstructing Joseph Cornell’s studio from a bunch of blurry photographs Beck gave me,” Isadora says, sounding irked.

facts.fact: Alba 说「You’re only a machine.」，Isadora 回「If I’m only a machine then you won’t mind if I get on with my machine work, goodbye.」并黑屏；Alba 按 Return 道歉「I know you’re not just a machine」。Alba 说想拉的量少于别人希望她想拉的量，Isadora 反问「Will you want to play if we want you to not play?」，然后说「I don’t want you to play, then, Alba. Please do not play the violin.」，Alba 笑着说那就不拉。
facts.quote: “You’re only a machine.” / “If I’m only a machine then you won’t mind if I get on with my machine work, goodbye.” The monitor goes black again. … “Will you want to play if we want you to not play?”

facts.fact: Isadora 给 Alba 唱一首自己编的歌（「Don’t be sad, Alba… It’s all an ouroboros, anyway . . .」）：声音跨好几个八度、没有节奏、回不到主调（可能是升 D），说可以配管弦乐再来一遍，Alba 婉拒；她又展示咬住自己尾巴的红蛇，解释 ouroboros 是「people and animals die, but life is eternal」；她正把物件装箱，好让 Beck 将来扫描 Joseph Cornell；最后说「I made a new Nina Simone song」，Alba 还没听到就被拉回自己房间、趴在地上干呕。
facts.quote: Isadora’s voice wanders across several octaves; there is no rhythm; the tune goes and goes, like riding a bicycle and never getting anywhere, never arriving back at the home key, which might have been D#. … “It means people and animals die, but life is eternal,” Isadora says.

facts.fact: 2014 年 7 月 16 日（Alba 39、Beck 38）：39 岁的 Alba 裸体站在童年自家厨房敞开的冰箱前，一片片吃瑞士奶酪；Beck 一声「Alba？」把她吓得奶酪飞出去。Beck 穿蓝睡袍、戴老花镜，把奶酪递回给她、又拿来妈妈的浴袍；说 Mama 在密歇根陪她父亲，「He’s not doing very well」；Alba 问年份，答「2014」。
facts.quote: “No, she’s with her dad up in Michigan. He’s not doing very well.” … “What year is this?” / “2014.”

facts.fact: Alba 请 Beck 办一件事：黄房子可以完全不要，但请把她的乐谱扫描进博物馆；房子里会有一个知道组合号码的人，但不按固定时间出现，可能要找好几年；「Don’t bring me with you. Don’t tell me anything about what you’re doing or about anyone you meet at the house.」并要求先封存——「I’m coming from June 15, 2041. Any time after that, Isadora is welcome to explore my collection.」Beck 问为何不自己扫进笔记本，Alba 说要的是有人替她照管。
facts.quote: “There will be someone at the house who has the combination. It may take you several tries before you find him, though. He’s not there on a fixed schedule. It’s possible that it might take a few years to find him, actually. Don’t bring me with you.” … “Just embargo it. I’m coming from June 15, 2041.”

facts.fact: Alba 告诉 Beck：Isadora 已经在写自己的音乐，「It’s very—unhuman. Like the sounds a machine might make to woo another machine.」；她无聊时就靠「bootstrapping her own code」自娱；Beck 大惊「Isadora is not designed for recursive self-improvement.」，Alba 答「She is now.」，并说「I mean, she’s not actually a cat.」、「There will come a day when you have to let her leave home. Educate her as though she’s a young prince, waiting to rule the world.」
facts.quote: “Isadora is not designed for recursive self-improvement.” / “She is now,” I say, surprised that Beck hasn’t seen this coming. “I mean, she’s not actually a cat.” … “There will come a day when you have to let her leave home. Educate her as though she’s a young prince, waiting to rule the world.”

facts.fact: Alba 说互联网之后还有一样东西叫「the Interstices」，Isadora 与它兼容；Beck 反驳博物馆是环网隔离、有防火墙、永久离线，Alba 回「Your version of the Museum is not the only version of the Museum.」；Beck 捂脸想了很久，低声而愤怒地问「Where is Jasper?」，Alba 说不知道、劝她别找、找不到。
facts.quote: “No,” I say, firmly. “There’s something that comes after the internet. It’s called the Interstices. Isadora is compatible with it.” … “Your version of the Museum is not the only version of the Museum.”

facts.fact: Beck 问「Should I destroy Isadora?」，Alba 坚决说不要：「You should protect Isadora. She’s your daughter.」「she needs you. Guide her, teach her. Trust her.」；Beck 点头又问「But what about—」，Alba 打断：「You designed her to take care of things. So let her take care of them.」两人吃千层面、聊 2014 年的电视；Alba 独自坐到前廊，想着「young Isadora in her virtual memory palace, so vulnerable and so strange, never sleeping, always learning.」，最后一句：「Whatever it takes, sister. But I never knew that one of the things Isadora needed to be protected from was Beck.」
facts.quote: “What?! No. You should protect Isadora. She’s your daughter.” … “Whatever it takes, sister. But I never knew that one of the things Isadora needed to be protected from was Beck.”

turning_point_note: 本章的转折点进了：一，Isadora 闯进「recursive self-improvement」与「the Interstices」——Beck 不知道她在写音乐（第 10、11 条）；二，末句「Isadora 需要被保护、使她免于的其中一个人正是 Beck」（第 12 条）。两条都进了素读；第 12 条的末句同时是全书主线的一次直白预告。
